PYTHONPATH=. python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json, sys
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ws_freezegun_config', 'freezegun/config.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print(json.dumps({'module_origin': spec.origin}))
cases = []
mod.reset_config()
mod.configure(extend_ignore_list=['a', 'b', 'a', 'c', 'b'])
got = list(mod.settings.default_ignore_list)
deduped = list(dict.fromkeys(got))
cases.append({'case': 'extend_dedupes_preserving_order', 'pass': got == deduped and got[-3:] == ['a', 'b', 'c'], 'got': got[-5:]})
mod.reset_config()
mod.configure(default_ignore_list=['x'])
cases.append({'case': 'default_list_replace', 'pass': list(mod.settings.default_ignore_list) == ['x'], 'got': list(mod.settings.default_ignore_list)})
print(json.dumps({'cases': cases}, sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if cases and all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
